independenceLimit: Fourteen independently authored task groups, not forty-two independent problems. Seven held-out groups are a small bounded pilot, not population validation. Similar concern families across groups are not claimed statistically independent.
holdoutVisibility: Public committed fixture data, not secret from the author/checker. Held-out means not used for prompt/threshold tuning or evaluated-profile input. Independent oracle admission is still pending.
contaminationRule: Any use of held-out outcomes to change a tuple member creates a new candidate; retain the failed attempt and use fresh groups or explicitly reclassify the seen groups as calibration before a new freeze.
